name: Authoritative task-graph snapshots
description:
Make task-graph snapshots authoritative before the renderer or detached viewer consumes them. The current bug is not in the selected-workflow UI logic; it is upstream in the snapshot reads that can return workflow metadata plus only a partial task set, leaving a real workflow with no mini DAG until a later forced refresh.

This workflow keeps the fix reviewable as two tightly-coupled implementation slices inside one workflow: first align owner-delegated `tasks` reads with the fresh-from-DB contract, then align the shared `invoker:get-tasks` app-bridge snapshot builder and its transport callsites to the same contract. The UI logic stays unchanged and existing churn/selection regressions remain the guardrails.

Standalone workflow waiver:
- The user explicitly asked for one `plans/invoker-handoff.yaml` file and live submission.
- The two implementation slices are one reviewer claim: every task-graph snapshot path becomes authoritative.
- Splitting this into a workflow chain would add merge-gate overhead without creating a clearer review boundary than owner delegation vs app bridge already provide inside this single workflow.

Publication note: this repo is Invoker itself, so keep `onFinish: pull_request` and `mergeMode: external_review`; once the resulting commit stack is ready, publish or update it with `mergify stack push`.

name: Planning tmux failed-restore id clear
description:
Clear dead planning tmux shell ids when boot restore fails.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- The restore-failure branch in `packages/app/src/terminal-session-ipc.ts:449-463`
  flips status but keeps the old `terminalSessionId`, leaving a phantom shell

name: Planning tmux boot-restore gate
description:
Reopen planning tmux only for chats that are still active tmux chats.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- `packages/app/src/terminal-session-ipc.ts:428-455` restores any non-exited

name: Planning tmux chat-mode cleanup

name: Planning session restore identity repair
description:
Persist enough planner identity to restore saved planning chats even when the
preset map changes.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:217-236` persists only `presetKey`.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:342-369` rebuilds tool/model from the
  current preset map at restore time.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:774-776` skips restore entirely when the
  saved `presetKey` no longer resolves.

name: Planning terminal preset ownership repair
description:
Make harness/model selection belong to the active planning chat instead of one
global renderer variable.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:844-845` stores one global planning preset.
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:2654-2657` sends that global preset on every
  planning request.
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:3914-3922` changes only the active chat id when the
  user switches chats.
- `packages/app/src/__tests__/in-app-planner.test.ts:265-295` proves the
  backend keeps the original preset for an existing planning session.

name: Planning terminal continuity repair
description:
Preserve the active planning conversation when restore data arrives late or
when the first failed send still returned the real backend planning session
id.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:1047-1067` hydrates planning chats with no guard
  for an already-edited local chat.
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:2648-2696` ignores `result.sessionId` on the
  failed first-send path, so the UI can stay on a local placeholder even
  though the backend already minted a real planning session.

name: Planning terminal adverse proof harness

Add the proof surface for planning-terminal lifecycle failures before changing
product behavior.

Verified root cause inputs from this checkout:
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:1047-1067` can overwrite a live local planning chat
  with late restore data.
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:2648-2696` drops `result.sessionId` on the failed
  first-send path.
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:844-845`, `:2654-2657`, and `:3914-3922` keep
  harness selection global instead of session-scoped.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:217-236`, `:342-369`, and `:774-776`
  restore planner identity from preset lookup only.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:648-660`, `:687-708`, and
  `packages/app/src/terminal-session-ipc.ts:428-455` leave tmux ownership
  metadata alive when the chat is back in `chat` mode or already submitted.

This is the bottom-of-stack proof slice. It adds the deterministic repro loop
and focused adverse tests only; later workflows make those new failures pass.

name: Bugfix: main-process planner surfaces lazy-load
description:
Fix the desktop main-process startup crash caused by eager `@invoker/surfaces`
loading in `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts`.

Verified facts from this checkout:
- `packages/app/src/main.ts:249-261` imports `./in-app-planner.js` during
  startup.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:42-43` eagerly imports
  `@invoker/surfaces`, while `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:119-141`
  already contains a later lazy loader.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:342-370` uses the surfaces-backed
  harness-session-driver selector while building the planning conversation
  config, so the eager module import is enough to crash before any planning
  session exists.
- Focused planner restore tests currently pass, so the fix should preserve
  create/restore/submit/tmux behavior while moving only the runtime load
  boundary.

name: Bugfix: explicit planning session continuity
description:
Stop the planning terminal from silently starting a brand-new conversation
when a follow-up send loses the real planning session identity.

Verified root cause from this checkout:
- `packages/ui/src/App.tsx:857` and `:2654-2659` only send `sessionId` when the
  active planning chat id is not local.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:514-527` silently creates a fresh
  session whenever the incoming `sessionId` is missing or not found.
- focused test runs showed `Turn 1: ... historyMsgs=0`, `Turn 2: ...
  historyMsgs=2`, and `responsePreview="Hello. What should we plan?"`, which
  proves the symptom is the new-session path.

Standalone workflow waiver: the user explicitly requested one submitted YAML
handoff file at `plans/invoker-handoff.yaml`. Keep one workflow, but split
the implementation into two behavior slices plus focused proof tasks so each
task still carries one local review claim.

name: Bugfix: truthful planning draft readiness
description:
Make planning chat only advertise or accept `submit` when the current session
has a real current-turn draft.

Root cause from the verified investigation:
- `PlanConversation` can save and show an assistant reply that says `Reply
  \`submit\` to submit it.` even when neither the draft file nor inline YAML
  produced a real draft.
- the in-app terminal command path accepts typed `submit` without first
  checking `draft_ready` / `draftPlanAvailable`.
- backend submit then fails late because `session.draftPlanText` is empty.

Standalone workflow waiver: the user explicitly requested one submitted YAML
handoff file at `plans/invoker-handoff.yaml`. Keep one workflow, but split the
implementation into three sequential behavior tasks so each task still makes
one local review claim inside the same end-to-end draft-readiness state
machine.
